anti_overlap: fd-experimental-flag-stability covers the fallback path when teams are unavailable, not cost measurement
fd-interflux-synthesis-pipeline covers write path for synthesis doc, not cost attribution
fd-agent-teams-primitive covers primitive API contracts, not session cost instrumentation
decision_lens: The brainstorm requires cost measurement as an acceptance criterion. Evaluate whether the proposed interstat hookup (before/after synthesis stage, writing synthesis_tokens and synthesis_cost_usd to frontmatter) actually captures the full cost of a teams run — including all 4 teammate sessions, not just the lead's session.
focus: Validate the cost model for --teams synthesis against the $2.93/landable baseline — per-teammate token scaling, interstat measurement hookup, and whether the cost gate is enforceable before synthesis runs
name: fd-teams-cost-economics
persona: Apply the perspective of a cost-efficiency engineer who owns the token-cost measurement pipeline for AI agent workflows — including interstat session-cost instrumentation, per-run cost attribution, and the specific ways multi-agent sessions with parallel subagents can produce misleading cost figures when session boundaries don't align with agent boundaries.
review_areas: Per-teammate session attribution: in a 4-teammate team, each teammate runs in its own session; interstat captures per-session costs; does the proposed 'before/after synthesis stage' measurement instrument all 4 sessions, or only the lead's orchestrating session?

Linear scaling assumption: the brainstorm states 'linear-per-teammate token cost' — verify this holds for the 4-teammate fixed design; fixed team size means 4x synthesis cost relative to single-Sonnet subagent, not N-linear; the per-run cost delta is bounded and known

Baseline comparison validity: the 'subagent-path baseline tokens (estimated from current synthesis subagent average)' is an estimate, not a per-run measurement — if synthesis token usage varies widely by brainstorm size, the comparison line in frontmatter may be misleading

Cost gate enforceability: the brainstorm says --teams must be opt-in to honor the cost gate — but there's no pre-flight cost estimate before synthesis runs; a user who opts in has no warning that this specific run might cost 4x the baseline
interstat session-cost query correctness: does interstat session-cost correctly sum tokens across all subagent sessions spawned by a parent session, or only the parent session's own tokens?

Cost measurement failure path: if interstat is unavailable or returns an error mid-synthesis, does the run proceed without cost data, abort, or write a sentinel value to frontmatter? Unhandled failure silently omits the required measurement

severity_examples.condition: synthesis_cost_usd in frontmatter understates actual cost by ~3x; cost gate cannot be honored; teams mode silently exceeds baseline
severity_examples.scenario: interstat captures only the lead's session tokens; 3 debater sessions are attributed to separate sessions not linked to the synthesis stage measurement

severity_examples.condition: No error handling for measurement failure; acceptance criterion #3 is silently violated
severity_examples.scenario: interstat is unavailable during synthesis; run proceeds without writing synthesis_tokens or synthesis_cost_usd; brainstorm doc has no cost data

severity_examples.condition: Fixed baseline estimate does not scale with brainstorm size; comparison is misleading
severity_examples.scenario: Baseline estimate is derived from a 3-agent-spec synthesis run; the benchmark target has 15 specs; actual baseline is 5x higher than the stored estimate; comparison line shows teams mode as cheaper than baseline

success_hints: Cost measurement instruments all 4 teammate sessions, not just the lead — via interstat parent-session aggregation or explicit per-session capture
Pre-flight estimate (even rough) is shown to the user before teams synthesis launches
Baseline comparison is measured per-run against the same spec set, not a stored average
interstat unavailability is handled explicitly — either abort with clear error or write a 'measurement unavailable' sentinel
task_context: The brainstorm requires writing synthesis_tokens and synthesis_cost_usd to the brainstorm doc's frontmatter and a comparison line against subagent-path baseline. The $2.93/landable baseline is the project-wide cost floor. Teams synthesis is opt-in precisely because of linear-per-teammate cost concern.
